name: io.github.inite-ai/inite-billing-service
title: INITE Billing & Wallet
description: Billing for AI agents: entitlements, credits, checkout links, an agent wallet paying over x402.

headers.name: X-Api-Key
headers.description: Service key for a product module acting for its customers. Leave empty to sign in with your INITE account (OAuth).

auth.https://billing.inite.ai/mcp/wallet: OAuth 2.0 (RFC 9728) via https://auth-api.inite.ai, scope wallet:pay — an agent acting for a person within passkey-approved limits, or on its own did:web identity
auth.https://billing.inite.ai/mcp: OAuth 2.0 (RFC 9728) via https://auth-api.inite.ai, scope billing:account — or a service key
